maria (Revenue): Heads up — noticed ~ $47.9k discrepancy on the deferred revenue schedule for Mar->Apr. Looks like a CloudRack vendor invoice (INV-78945) landed late AND a spring pricing experiment promo was applied to a chunk of hosted usage. Can we triage impact and propose revrec treatment? cc nate, alex

billing-bot: New vendor invoice received: INV-78945 from CloudRack. Total: $47,920. Posted 2026-03-22 14:02 UTC.

nate (Billing): I pulled INV-78945. Vendor billed at promo rate; our ratecard mapping tagged the line as "promo_credit" instead of "prepay_service" so it flowed to credits. That caused deferred revenue to be under-recognized.

alex (FP&A): Can you give a quick P&L impact estimate — how much was recognized vs should have been deferred?

maria (Revenue): Quick calc: of $47,920, ~ $42,000 should've been deferred (12-month amort), and ~$5,920 was recognized immediately due to the mapping. Net impact to this month is ~ $3.2k over-recognition and ~ $38.8k needs to be moved back into deferral. (ballpark, will reconcile exact cents)

nate (Billing): I can run a reclass but need formal approval for a manual correcting journal for month-end close. Suggested JE (example):

```
Journal - March 2026
Dr Sales Revenue 3,200
Cr Deferred Revenue 3,200
Memo: Reclassify promo mis-mapped CloudRack INV-78945 (manual correction)
```

alex (FP&A): Need backup before I sign off: vendor invoice PDF, the ratecard snapshot at time of billing, and a short note describing the pricing experiment and why lines should be classified as prepay. maria, can you collate?

maria (Revenue): I'll upload the invoice and ratecard to the finance folder. Links: https://files.redwood/INV-78945.pdf and https://docs.redwood/pricing/exp-2026-spring (dev notes). Also adding the experiment config showing the promo flag.

nate (Billing): Thanks. For audit trail I'll create a workpaper: "INV-78945 manual reclass" and tag the JE. Also opening a ratecard mapping PR to prevent future mis-tags.

olivia (CFO): I reviewed the summary and approve the manual JE for the month close. Please route the invoice + workpaper + journal template to accounting@redwood.com and cc me. :white_check_mark:

maria (Revenue): Appreciate it. I'll add a short memo to the workpaper explaining the pricing experiment leak and expected exposure if uncorrected. Also plan to add a GA checklist item to confirm promo vs prepay mappings at billing cutoffs. :memo:

nate (Billing): Will post the JE and attach the supporting docs before EOD close. I'll also include the PR link for the mapping fix in the workpaper.

alex (FP&A): Once posted, I'll update the close pack and adjust the deferred revenue schedule. Also tagging this for the quarterly controls review to ensure experiments don't bypass billing validation. :eyes:

maria (Revenue): Good plan. If anyone spots related invoices from CloudRack in the last 60 days, please flag them here.

nate (Billing): quick check: INV-78899 and INV-79001 look ok, only 78945 had the promo flag.

maria (Revenue): ok closing loop — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short root-cause note after PR merges.
